title: Protein expression on the surface of Escherichia coli
author: Maja Rennig
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bfh4jj8w

steps.title: Prepare overnight culture
steps.instruction: Inoculate a fresh colony of BL21 (DE3) strain containing the expression vector into LB medium supplemented with relevant antibiotics.

substeps.instruction: Grow the culture overnight at 37 °C with 250 RPM shaking.
Ensure the overnight culture volume is at least 1/100 of the intended expression culture volume.

steps.title: Expand culture to target density
steps.instruction: Dilute the overnight culture 1:100 into fresh LB supplemented with relevant antibiotics.

substeps.instruction: Grow the culture at 37 °C with 250 RPM shaking until an OD600 of 0.5 - 0.6 is reached.

steps.title: Induce protein expression
steps.instruction: Induce expression by adding L-rhamnose to a final concentration of 5 millimolar (mM).

substeps.instruction: Incubate the culture at 30 °C with 250 RPM shaking for up to 20:00:00.

steps.title: Harvest cells for activity assay
steps.instruction: Collect cells for activity testing by centrifugation and resuspension.

substeps.instruction: Spin the culture down at 4000 x g for 5 minutes at 4 °C.
Resuspend the pellet in the desired assay buffer (e.g., 10 millimolar (mM) - 50 millimolar (mM) Tris-HCl).
Run activity assay in liquid or on agar plates.

steps.title: Prepare cells for TEV cleavage
steps.instruction: Harvest cells and resuspend in cleavage buffer.

substeps.instruction: Spin the culture down at 4000 x g for 5 minutes at 4 °C.
Resuspend the pellet in either 10 millimolar (mM) Tris-HCl or 100 µL/ODU TEV cleavage buffer (10 millimolar (mM) Tris-HCl pH 7.5, 150 millimolar (mM) NaCl, 0.5 millimolar (mM) EDTA).

steps.title: Perform TEV protease cleavage
steps.instruction: Cleave the protein using purified and activated TEV protease.

substeps.instruction: Add purified and activated TEV protease to the resuspended cells.
Incubate at room temperature overnight (~16:00:00), or for a shorter duration if harvesting on the same day.

steps.title: Collect and store protein extractions
steps.instruction: Separate the cleaved protein from the cells and store appropriately.

substeps.instruction: Spin the cells at 5000 x g for 10 minutes at 4 °C.
Keep extractions on ice during use and store at 4 °C.
